localChanges: Computer players' Settlers, and your Automated Settlers, now irrigate first around cities that are short of food (closes #383).
They also clear Swamp and Jungle on squares a city works, and clear Forest where the Plains left behind can then be irrigated (closes #353, closes #386).
When a square worth irrigating has no water next to it, they bring the water to it first, for example by clearing a Forest beside the sea and irrigating the Plains (closes #426).
